sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: MTA-STS 與 TLS-RPT：郵件傳輸加密驗收
related.titleEn: MTA-STS and TLS-RPT: mail-transport encryption acceptance
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：82.5%與87.5%由去重聯集重算，對齊與驗證欄分開；通過郵件仍需內容與使用者風險判斷。 交付400筆合成對齊表、聯集重算與合法轉寄例外評估。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 82.5% and 87.5% from deduplicated unions, retain separate alignment/result fields and preserve content-risk review. Deliver 400 synthetic alignment rows, union calculations and legitimate-forwarding evaluation.
related.difference: 列出測試MX名稱、政策模式、有效期及憑證名稱；用合成TLS-RPT把失敗分為連線、名稱與信任鏈問題，與DMARC內容層判斷分開。
related.differenceEn: List test MX names, policy mode, lifetime and certificate names; classify synthetic TLS-RPT failures into connection, name and trust-chain issues, separately from DMARC.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: DMARC通過集合=已對齊SPF通過 OR 已對齊DKIM通過；聯集需扣重疊，並另處理轉寄與郵件清單的合法變形。 400封合成郵件中，300封SPF已對齊通過、280封DKIM已對齊通過，250封同時符合。 聯集300+280−250=330封，通過率82.5%；DKIM改320且重疊270時聯集350封、87.5%。
傳輸成功率=成功的報告sessions/報告總sessions；報告涵蓋率需另外追蹤，缺報告不代表成功。 教學日報1000個sessions，其中40失敗；此樣本僅含有回報的寄送端。 (1000−40)/1000×100=96%；同樣1000筆中只剩10失敗時為99%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: DMARC passing set is aligned SPF pass OR aligned DKIM pass; subtract overlap and separately examine legitimate forwarding/list transformations. Among 400 synthetic messages, 300 pass aligned SPF, 280 pass aligned DKIM and 250 pass both. Union is 300+280−250=330 messages or 82.5%; DKIM 320 and overlap 270 yield 350 or 87.5%.

Transport success rate equals successful reported sessions divided by reported sessions; track reporting coverage separately because missing reports do not prove success. A teaching daily report contains 1000 sessions with 40 failures, covering only reporting senders. (1000−40)/1000×100=96%; with 10 failures among the same 1000 sessions, success is 99%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Elastic ECS：事件時間、型別與正規化契約
related.titleEn: Elastic ECS: event time, types and normalization contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：82.5%與87.5%由去重聯集重算，對齊與驗證欄分開；通過郵件仍需內容與使用者風險判斷。 交付400筆合成對齊表、聯集重算與合法轉寄例外評估。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Recompute 82.5% and 87.5% from deduplicated unions, retain separate alignment/result fields and preserve content-risk review. Deliver 400 synthetic alignment rows, union calculations and legitimate-forwarding evaluation.
related.difference: 把合成原始時間、收集時間與索引時間映射到明確欄位；逐一指定時區、秒/毫秒與IP/port型別，保留原始資料來源。
related.differenceEn: Map synthetic occurrence, collection and indexing times to explicit fields; define timezone, seconds/milliseconds and IP/port types while retaining raw provenance.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: DMARC通過集合=已對齊SPF通過 OR 已對齊DKIM通過；聯集需扣重疊，並另處理轉寄與郵件清單的合法變形。 400封合成郵件中，300封SPF已對齊通過、280封DKIM已對齊通過，250封同時符合。 聯集300+280−250=330封，通過率82.5%；DKIM改320且重疊270時聯集350封、87.5%。
管線延遲=ingest_time−event_time，僅在兩端時鐘可比較時有意義；正規化不能把發生時間覆寫成收到時間。 同一時基下事件時間100000毫秒、索引時間100350毫秒；時間戳均已轉成整數毫秒。 100350−100000=350毫秒；索引時間改100900時延遲900毫秒。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: DMARC passing set is aligned SPF pass OR aligned DKIM pass; subtract overlap and separately examine legitimate forwarding/list transformations. Among 400 synthetic messages, 300 pass aligned SPF, 280 pass aligned DKIM and 250 pass both. Union is 300+280−250=330 messages or 82.5%; DKIM 320 and overlap 270 yield 350 or 87.5%.

Pipeline latency is ingest_time−event_time and requires comparable clocks; normalization must not overwrite occurrence time with arrival time. On one time basis, event time is 100000 ms and ingest time 100350 ms; both timestamps are normalized integer milliseconds. 100350−100000=350 ms; ingest time 100900 yields 900 ms.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
